import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to the SQLite database
db_path = '⟨workdir⟩'
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# Calculate table-wide distribution of decision_speed_category
table_wide_query = '''
SELECT decision_speed_category, COUNT(*) as table_count, 
       COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lever__hiring_manager_scorecard) as table_pct
FROM lever__hiring_manager_scorecard
GROUP BY decision_speed_category
'''

table_wide_df = pd.read_sql_query(table_wide_query, conn)

# Calculate distribution by performance_tier
tier_dist_query = '''
SELECT performance_tier, decision_speed_category, COUNT(*) as tier_count
FROM lever__hiring_manager_scorecard
GROUP BY performance_tier, decision_speed_category
'''

tier_dist_df = pd.read_sql_query(tier_dist_query, conn)

# Merge and calculate divergence
merged_df = pd.merge(tier_dist_df, table_wide_df, on='decision_speed_category')

# Calculate percentage within each tier
merged_df['tier_pct'] = merged_df.groupby('performance_tier')['tier_count'].transform(
    lambda x: x / x.sum() * 100
)

# Calculate divergence from table-wide distribution
merged_df['divergence'] = abs(merged_df['tier_pct'] - merged_df['table_pct'])

# Get top diverging combinations
top_divergence = merged_df.sort_values('divergence', ascending=False).head(10)

# Close connection
conn.close()

print("Top 10 Performance Tier - Decision Speed Category Combinations with Highest Divergence:")
print("=" * 80)
print(top_divergence[['performance_tier', 'decision_speed_category', 'tier_count', 'tier_pct', 'table_pct', 'divergence']].to_string(index=False))
